answer: Because the timing is published against the trellis challenge, the echo audit can replay the anchor history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A scripted farm thus has to pad 34 submissions and hold each member open and idle instead of firing and forgetting, which forfeits the operator in machine time and adds nothing to the reward. A farm of 4734 identities would post 2498 proofs and burn roughly 27 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
